output.question: What are Whirlpool's subsidiaries?
output.answer: Whirlpool Corporation’s latest subsidiary list located is Exhibit 21 to its annual report for December 31, 2025, filed February 11, 2026. Listed subsidiaries include KitchenAid, Inc.; KitchenAid Global LLC; InSinkErator LLC; Maytag Limited; Maytag Sales, Inc.; Maytag Properties, LLC; Maytag Worldwide N.V.; Whirlpool Canada LP; Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda.; Whirlpool Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V.; Whirlpool America LLC; Brasmotor Ltda.; and Parex Industries Ltd., among others. Whirlpool of India Limited should not be treated as a consolidated subsidiary: Whirlpool reported deconsolidating it following its November 2025 stake reduction.

key_facts.fact: The subsidiary exhibit accompanies the annual report for December 31, 2025, filed February 11, 2026.
As of December 31, 2025, listed subsidiaries include KitchenAid, Inc.; KitchenAid Global LLC; InSinkErator LLC; Maytag Limited; Maytag Sales, Inc.; Maytag Properties, LLC; and Maytag Worldwide N.V.

As of December 31, 2025, other listed subsidiaries include Whirlpool Canada LP; Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda.; Whirlpool Mexico, S. de R.L. de C.V.; Whirlpool America LLC; Brasmotor Ltda.; and Parex Industries Ltd.
The annual report states that Whirlpool India was deconsolidated following the November 2025 ownership reduction.

passages.quote: as a result of the deconsolidation of Whirlpool India.
